comparison.objective: Measure a pin diameter with a digital caliper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a pin square but compliant while gently closing the measuring jaw without excess force.
comparison.success_condition: Reading within 0.05 mm, alignment within 1°, jaw force at most 0.3 N; available versions specify detailed partial thresholds.
comparison.reason: Precision alignment and force regulation are shared primitives, but the tested outcome is metrology under light contact, not impact fracture and containment.
